hypothesis: the arithmetic transfer effect replicates on two non-GSM8K sources (SVAMP and ASDiv), all families positive and significant on each
methods: ROOT="$PYTHON_EVO_REPO_ROOT"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || { echo "no repo root" >&2; exit 1; }; export EVO_REPO_ROOT="$ROOT"; export EVO_REPO_ROOT="$ROOT"; PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/src:$ROOT/demo/shared:$ROOT/demo/transfer" python3 "$ROOT/demo/transfer/run_cross_dataset.py" --selftest && PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/src:$ROOT/demo/shared:$ROOT/demo/transfer" EVO_OUT="$RD/artifacts" EVO_SEED=20261012 EVO_MODELS="qwen2.5:7b,gemma3:4b,llama3.1:8b" python3 "$ROOT/demo/transfer/run_cross_dataset.py"

kill_switch.note: the effect replicates on two independent arithmetic sources: the claim is dataset-robust
the effect does not replicate on at least one independent source: narrow the claim to GSM8K-style items

tension: The entire confirmatory record runs on GSM8K-style arithmetic, and a reviewer's first ask is whether the effect is a property of one dataset's surface idiom rather than of arithmetic itself. Models can acquire a surface form and fail on differently-phrased arithmetic, and no arm has tested an independently-sourced set. Answering it decides whether the primary claim is about arithmetic or about GSM8K's idiom, and one dataset is not enough because one dataset is what the record already has.
